meta.title: Binbang – Pricing
meta.description: Binbang is free. We charge you nothing and earn a commission when a booking is made through the link in an alert email.
meta.ogDescription: Binbang pricing. Free to use, no fees.

hero.heading: Binbang is free
hero.subline1: You pay nothing to set up or receive alerts.
hero.subline2: We never ask for a payment method.
hero.description: We earn a commission from the booking platform when a stay is booked through the link in your alert email. That is why we do not charge you.

free.title: No fees
free.description: Setting up and receiving alerts costs nothing. There are no paid plans and no payment details to enter.

coverage.title: What you get
coverage.description: Up to 50 alerts, and we check your property and dates every 30 minutes.

feedback.title: How we are funded
feedback.description: When a booking happens through the link in an alert email, the booking platform pays us a commission.

step1.title: Pick a property and dates
step1.description: Search from the home page, choose your dates, and leave your email. No account needed.

step2.title: We check every 30 minutes
step2.description: We watch your dates around the clock. When a room opens, you get an email.

step3.title: Book through the link
step3.description: Booking via the link in the email keeps us running. You are free to book elsewhere if you prefer.

cta.title: Set your first alert
cta.description: Search and set an alert in under a minute. Questions are always welcome.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: Yes. We charge no fees and never ask for a payment method. There are no paid plans.
faq.q2: How many alerts can I set?
faq.a2: Up to 50. We check every 30 minutes.
faq.q3: How do I stop the alerts?
faq.a3: Click the unsubscribe link at the bottom of any alert email, or delete the alert from your dashboard.
